accountGovernance.title: Account governance
accountGovernance.subtitle: Review and act on student and partner accounts. Every suspension or reinstatement is recorded with your name, the reason, and a timestamp.
accountGovernance.auditNotice: Suspending or reinstating an account is an audited action. Your identity, the reason you enter, and the time are all recorded.

accountGovernance.selfNote: You can't suspend your own account.
accountGovernance.emptyBody: Try a different search term or filter.
accountGovernance.statusEmptyBody: Change the status filter or move to another page.
accountGovernance.permissionBody: You need the account-governance permission for your university to manage accounts. Ask a platform administrator to grant it.
accountGovernance.suspendDesc: The account holder is signed out and blocked from signing in until reinstated.
accountGovernance.reinstateDesc: The account holder can sign in again immediately.
